paragraphs.text: McCoy’s Grocery in Ecru says it will close at 6:30 p.m. beginning Monday, Nov. 2, according to an announcement on the store’s Facebook page.
The store lists its address as 338 Main Street in Ecru and its business telephone as 662-489-3161.

The announcement gives the new closing time and effective date but does not list opening times or day-specific exceptions. Customers needing those details can check with the store; the original notice and business profile are linked below.
